positiveFactors: Optimal arterial blood pressure within recommended physiological range.

recommendations.title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I)
recommendations.detail: First-line clinical treatment for insomnia. Implement stimulus control (bed is strictly for sleep) and sleep restriction protocols.

recommendations.title: Digital Curfew & Circadian Photobiology
recommendations.detail: Cease exposure to high-energy blue wavelength light 60-90 minutes prior to targeted sleep onset to allow natural melatonin surge.

recommendations.title: Autonomic Downregulation Routine
recommendations.detail: Incorporate 10 minutes of cyclic sighing or 4-7-8 parasympathetic breathwork prior to bed to reduce nocturnal resting heart rate.
